pkgmetadata.longdescription: See README.md and REQUIREMENTS.md of drowse.

use.flag: Install the profiles of sys-apps/tuned cm5-powersave and cm5-powersave-no-radio (a Raspberry Pi 5 or CM5 while idle) as profiles, not only as examples
Install /etc/sway/config.d/80-idlehint.conf: a gui-apps/swayidle that sets the idle hint of the session of sway for logind, which drowse needs
Install the module of gui-apps/waybar and its style in /etc/xdg/waybar
